unreported_year <- df %>%
  group_by(PY) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Unreported = sum(AU_UN == "UNREPORTED", na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = 100 * Unreported / Total
  )

unreported_year
unreported_year <- df |>
  filter(is.na(AU_UN) | AU_UN == "") |>
  count(PY, name = "Unreported")

total_year <- df |>
  count(PY, name = "Total")

unreported_pct <- total_year |>
  left_join(unreported_year, by = "PY") |>
  mutate(
    Unreported = ifelse(is.na(Unreported), 0, Unreported),
    Percent = Unreported / Total * 100
  )

Annual percentage of records with unreported affiliation.

ggplot(
  unreported_pct,
  aes(PY, Percent)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      xend = PY,
      y = 0,
      yend = Percent
    ),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#d73027",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Publication Year",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(

library(dplyr)

        sort = TRUE)

  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  filter(

  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, Country) %>%
  count(Country, sort = TRUE)

top25_count <- count_prod %>%
  slice(1:25)

top25_count <- top25_count %>%
  mutate(
    Share = round(
      n / sum(n) * 100,
      2
    )
  )

  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      row_number() <= 10,
      "Top 5",
      "Others"

      size = 18
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

extract_university <- function(x){

  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\n", " ")

  pattern <- "(University[^,;]+|
               Universiti[^,;]+|
               Universidade[^,;]+|
               Universidad[^,;]+|
               Université[^,;]+|
               Technion[^,;]+|
               CERN|
               Institute of Physics|
               Eötvös Loránd University|
               Indian Institute of Technology[^,;]*)"

  result <- str_extract(x, pattern)

  return(result)
}

RQ 4 dan 5 (Topic Modeling using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA))

Import data and data preprocessing (remove punctuations, stopwords, lemmatization)

topic_df <- df_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(AB),
    AB != ""
  )

topic_df <- topic_df %>%
  mutate(
    AB =
      tolower(AB)
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[0-9]+",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[[:punct:]]",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[[:punct:]]",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB[1]
[1] "the average acceleration of a car or a sprint runner can be estimated from the time taken to travel a given distance  an improved estimate can be calculated if the speed at that time is known      the author s   published by iop publishing ltd "
library(tm)
library(textstem)

Creating corpus (document-term matrix/ “dtm”)

corpus <- Corpus(
  VectorSource(
    topic_df$AB
  )
)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  content_transformer(lemmatize_strings)
)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  removeWords,
  stopwords("english")
)

custom_stop <- c(
  "study",
  "paper",
  "article",
  "results",
  "education",
  "iop",   
  "publish",          
  "ltd",
  "also",
  "physic",
  "can",
  "using",
  "based",
  "student",
  "teach",

  "present",

)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  removeWords,
  custom_stop
)

dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(
  corpus,
  control = list(
    wordLengths = c(3, Inf)
  )
)

dtm <-
  removeSparseTerms(
    dtm,
    0.99
  )

Finding the best K (number of topics). Note. This section will consume your time a bit longer.

LDA modeling. Brace yourself. This section will consume your time a bit longer.

library(topicmodels)

lda_model <- LDA(
  dtm,
  k = 5,
  control =
    list(seed=123)
)

Extracting themes with represented words.

topic_terms <-
  terms(
    lda_model,
    30
  )

write.csv(topic_terms, "topic_terms.csv")

Create Visualization

topic_prob <-
  topicmodels::posterior(
    lda_model
  )$topics

df_abstract_clean <- df_clean |> filter(!is.na(AB))

topic_df <- cbind(df_abstract_clean, topic_prob)

rep_papers <- lapply(
  1:ncol(topic_terms),
  function(k){

    topic_name <- paste0(k)

    topic_df %>%
      arrange(desc(.data[[topic_name]])) %>%
      select(
        Topic = all_of(topic_name),
        TI_raw,
        AU2,
        PY
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Topic_ID = paste0("Topic ", k)
      )
  }
)

rep_papers <- bind_rows(rep_papers)
topic_df2 <- data.frame(
  Topic = apply(topic_prob, 1, which.max)
)

topic_share <- table(
  topic_df2$Topic
)

topic_share <-
  as.data.frame(
    topic_share
  )

ggplot(
  topic_share,
  aes(
    reorder(
      Var1,
      Freq
    ),
    Freq
  )
)+ labs(x = "Topics", y = "Number of Representative Papers") +

geom_col(
  fill="steelblue"
)+

coord_flip()+
theme_minimal()
